name: action-worldmodel-bench
description: Benchmarks action‑conditioned world models by testing a model’s ability to predict future observations or states given current observations and action sequences. It is intended to evaluate learned dynamics and planning utility of world models in simulated environments.
evaluation_method: MSE / task_success_rate (prediction error and downstream control performance)
reputation: Relatively small, research-oriented benchmark used for world-model and model-based RL evaluations with limited wider adoption.
